text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho gets injured during training
so I rush
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Please. You're making way too big a
deal about
this, Familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But I really did hurt myself. I guess that
means
we're done training, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay then, I'm going to the mountains!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's play it safe and rest for now...
Yeah, to play it safe, you should get some rest here...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?! I'm gonna pick
medicinal herbs.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I've already decided to gather
ingredients for
magic potions today.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why?! I'm fine! It's just gathering herbs!
I've made
up my mind, so don't try to
stop me!
choice_data_list: You have to stay in bed and rest.
Well, as long as it's just moving around...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Like I'd let that happen! Anyway, I'm in a
hurry,
so—
choice_data_list: What if mountain climbing makes your injury worse?
What if mountain climbing makes your injury worse?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
If you're gonna be like that,
then you better go
pick them for me!
choice_data_list: When I say no, I mean no.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I should have my
familiars
gather things for me in the first
place.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, get to it! I'm a busy genius magical
girl,
y'know. I can't change my plans!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As instructed, I hike up the mountain
and search
for herbs in place of Sweep
Tosho, while she stays
in the dorm and
sulks.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Just going to pick herbs is
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, just kidding! It doesn't hurt at all!
Anyway, I
need to get going before the
sun starts going d—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ow...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't seem okay at all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stop her right there and make her rest,
though
she seems unhappy the whole
time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but worry still, so I decide to

accompany her to the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
See, what did I tell you? I'm totally fine!
An injury
like this is nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to get those herbs! You
be sure to
pick some too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Japanese honeysuckle! I found
some! Over
here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, now I can make tons of magic
potions! And
hiking is kinda like training
too, so it's a
win-win! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, Sweep Tosho's injury
doesn't get any
worse, and the light
hiking doubles as training.
